title: Game-Ware Vol. 2
overview:
Game-Ware Vol. 2 is the second issue of a magazine on CD-ROM for the Sega Saturn, with small games, videos, interviews and advertisements.

- Aoi Mizu no Naka: a new suspense-horror Playing Movie Game serial
- Pipitboy no Daibouken 2, with an upgraded system
- Legend of Sarah part 1: a Virtua Fighter digital comic serial
- Telecom Town II, now a full shooting game
- Cinderella Cruising, starring a 4WD Challenger
- Information corner with NiGHTS game news, Gamera 2 movie news and Haruomi Hosono music news
- A playable demo of Layer Section
